title: The Judgment on Shebna and the Exaltation of Eliakim
description: The Lord sends judgment against the steward Shebna, who had carved out a magnificent tomb for himself in the rock. He will be thrown out like a ball to a distant land and removed from his position. In his place, God calls His servant Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, giving him Shebna's robe, sash, and authority, and placing the key to the house of David on his shoulder. He will be secured like a peg in a firm place, but the prophecy ends with the peg eventually giving way and falling along with all the burden hanging from it.
